records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales to customers outside the U.S. represented approximately 49% of total sales in the third quarter of 2021 compared to 51% during the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales of $712.0 million increased 23%; organic sales (which excludes acquisitions/divestitures and foreign currency translation) were up 15%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: These increases are a result of higher volume and price capture, partially offset by the fair value inventory step-up charges related to both the ABEL and Airtech acquisitions, inflation and supply chain constraints.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusted operating margin increased 120 basis points to 24.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusted operating income increased 29% to $173.1 million.
